description_en: You can call the ListSubscriptionByTopic operation to retrieve a paginated list of subscriptions for a topic
description_zh: 调用ListSubscriptionByTopic接口列出某个主题下的Subscription列表，可分页获取数据
kebab_example: aliyun mns-open list-subscription-by-topic --topic-name test --page-num 1 --page-size 20 --subscription-name demo-subscription --biz-endpoint-type example-string --endpoint-value example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSubscriptionByTopic

parameters.description_en:
The page number of the results to return.
Valid values: 1 to 100000000.
If the value is less than 1, the system uses 1. If the value is greater than 100000000, the system uses 100000000.
parameters.description_zh:
分页页码，查询第几页的返回结果。
取值范围：1~100000000。
若您设置的参数值小于1，则系统默认按照参数值为1处理；若您设置的参数值大于100000000，则系统默认按照参数值为100000000处理。

parameters.description_en:
The number of entries to return on each page.
Valid values: 10 to 50.
If the value is less than 10, the system uses 10. If the value is greater than 50, the system uses 50.
parameters.description_zh:

取值范围：10~50。
